summary: Kinross Gold furnished a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a home-country operations and capital-returns update) dated September 23, 2026, announcing it is raising its return-of-capital target from 40% to 50% of free cash flow to shareholders for 2026. The company also cut 2026 and 2027 production guidance by 2%-3%, to roughly 1.84-1.86 million Au eq. oz. annually, concentrated at La Coipa and Round Mountain, and raised cost guidance to about $1,850-$1,900/oz AISC. No board recommendation, advisor, or transaction terms were disclosed; watch free cash flow delivery and weather/grade risk.
